raw_comment: I noticed there are much more droughts near the rocky mountain and the middle of the US. Also, i noticed  that the areas with less incoming water experienced  way more droughts then areas with more water such as around the coast. I wonder why areas that are drier experience more droughts when they are in the center of the us. Also I wonder how individuals are affected by the droughts. This relates to my community because i live in New York where its dry and should bring awareness. A headline is " America is getting drier by the minute.
